incomplete_fix_quote: cgi-bin/awstats.pl?config= accepts an absolute pathname, even though it was intended to only read a file in the /etc/awstats/awstats.conf format. NOTE: this issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2017-1000501.
root_cause: wwwroot/cgi-bin/awstats.pl treats the config= query parameter as a config-file path in Read_Config (opening `$searchdir$SiteConfig`, then falling back to File::Spec->rel2abs($SiteConfig) for absolute paths). CVE-2017-1000501 (fixed in 7.7) is a `..` traversal; the 7.7 fix only strips `..` segments (`$SiteConfig =~ s/\.\.//g`). An ABSOLUTE config= path contains no `..`, so the substitution is a no-op and the rel2abs fallback opens the out-of-tree file == CVE-2020-29600. 7.8 closes it by commenting out the rel2abs absolute-path fallback.

patch_refs.v1_to_v2_29600_fix: eldy/awstats 7.7 -> 7.8, wwwroot/cgi-bin/awstats.pl Read_Config: File::Spec->rel2abs absolute-path fallback commented out
